description: Horizontal stage-by-stage heatmap of friction intensity across the value stream. Each stage cell shows label and intensity score (0–10 heat scale, green→amber→coral). Binding stage is visually distinguished with coral border and BINDING pill.

fieldDependencies.displayAs: Caption below the heatmap — value stream identifier string
One stage cell per element, ordered by stageIndex. Each cell shows label + frictionIntensity heat badge.
Stage identifier — used as data-stage-id attribute on each cell for deep-link targeting
0-based ordering index — determines left-to-right sequence of stage cells
0–10 integer drives heat badge colour: ≤5 muted, 6=#FCA5A5, 7=#F87171, 8=#EF4444, 9=#DC2626, 10=#991B1B
true → coral border, coral fill, BINDING pill label on stage cell
Placed as data-binding-stage-index attribute on binding stage cell for deep-link targeting from binding_constraint_card
